title: Tensor product of K-flat complexes is K-flat
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space. If $\mathcal K^\bullet$ and $\mathcal L^\bullet$ are K-flat complexes of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-kflat-complex], then $\operatorname{Tot}(\mathcal K^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal L^\bullet)$ is a K-flat complex of $\mathcal O_X$-modules.
